name: Sky Gold & Diamonds Ltd (Sky Gold Ltd)
tagline: Fast-scaling B2B jewellery manufacturer whose Q1FY27 print (revenue +78%, PAT +141%, first positive operating cash flow) starts to answer the cash-conversion doubts, though a single quarter and a 36x multiple keep it unproven
business_overview: Sky Gold is a B2B jewellery manufacturer (studded/18kt gold jewellery for retail brands) pursuing sustainable 30-35% sales growth, working toward becoming India's largest B2B jewellery manufacturer. Charges customers making charges on a percentage-of-gold-value basis (not per-gram), with 15-day repricing and MCX hedging to manage gold-price exposure. Recently acquired Ganna & Gold. Shifting mix toward an 'advance gold' model that lowers inventory funding and receivable intensity.
fundamentals_table: ROCE ~27% / ROE ~29% (headline); target 27%+ sustained by FY30
Revenue Rs 2,013 Cr (+78% YoY), PAT Rs 104.9 Cr (+141% YoY), EBITDA margin ~7.8%, gross margin ~9.3%
Q1FY27 operating cash flow turned POSITIVE (+Rs 30 Cr) for the first time; FY25 OCF was -Rs 273 Cr. Debtor days 38 -> 30-32, targeting 25-26; WC-cycle target 52-55 days by FY27
Gross debt ~Rs 540 Cr at Q1FY27-end; targeting net-debt-free by FY30
Revenue ~Rs 8,100 Cr; PAT margin 4.5-5.25% (implies PAT ~Rs 365-425 Cr). Capacity util ~60% (1.2 t/day), sufficient to 2028; next capex Rs 80-100 Cr, 120-day build
Rs 18,000-19,000 Cr revenue and net-debt-free by FY30; advance-gold mix to rise (exit run-rate ~20% vs FY26 ~11-12%)
fundamentals_narrative: Headline ROCE/ROE are strong, and the community's central concern - cash conversion - improved materially in Q1FY27: operating cash flow turned positive (+Rs 30 Cr) for the first time (FY25 OCF was -Rs 273 Cr on a Rs 434 Cr working-capital build), debtor days fell to 30-32 (from 38, targeting 25-26), and the advance-gold mix is rising toward a ~20% exit run-rate versus ~11-12% for FY26. Revenue grew 78% YoY to Rs 2,013 Cr and PAT 141% to Rs 104.9 Cr, with gross margin up to ~9.3% on advance-gold and value-added product mix. FY27 guidance is ~Rs 8,100 Cr revenue at 4.5-5.25% PAT margin. The still-open questions: it is one quarter of positive OCF, not a trend; gross debt is still ~Rs 540 Cr; EBITDA margin is thin at ~7.8% so the model is volume- and mix-dependent; and the stock trades at ~36x. The Feb-2026 receivables concern (>Rs 600 Cr, a disputed Gensol comparison) is being addressed by the improving debtor cycle but not fully retired. Promoter holding 51.74% with zero pledge.
sentiment_summary: Read 50 of 178 available posts (of 218 total) spanning Jun 2025 to Aug 2026. A sharp Jun 2025 episode - promoters sold ~3.5% stake to institutional/PE investors via warrant conversion, triggering a 5% lower-circuit move - was the dominant early theme; the community was split between viewing it as routine promoter monetization after two decades of no stake sales (partly corroborated by MF buying the same stake) versus a genuine conviction concern, compounded by a poorly-managed subsequent concall (communication/English-language issues cited by multiple posters). By Jul-Aug 2025, standalone (vs consolidated) revenue growth deceleration and flat gold volumes for 3 quarters added further caution, though one poster noted Q4/Q1 are seasonally lean quarters. From Feb 2026 the thread's central concern became working-capital/receivables quality, with the Gensol-comparison exchange described above. The most recent posts (Aug 2026) are cautiously constructive: a detailed Q1 FY27 review sets explicit conditions (PAT >Rs 100 Cr, CFO positive, Advance Gold 18-20% of mix, declining debt) under which the stock "starts looking increasingly attractive," without yet confirming those conditions are met.
community_signal: Vansh_Dhelia (trusted) called the Jun 2025 promoter-selling selloff "Mr. Market being a sad depressed Maniac" and stated underlying business economics and growth prospects remained fully intact - an explicit bullish read on the dip, though not phrased as a portfolio-weight disclosure. Ghonarbochon (trusted) engaged substantively and skeptically on the making-charge/margin-structure mechanics (Aug 2025), a technical clarification rather than a conviction call. Mudit.Kushalvardhan (trusted) pushed back on an unrelated income-tax-crackdown scare as inapplicable to Sky Gold. vikasbargale (trusted) shared informational videos twice, explicitly noting no position both times. Prabhat_Mohanty (trusted) drew a cautionary lesson from the episode about being wary of stock/sector hype. No trusted user made an explicit conviction/position-size disclosure in favor of the name (contrast: a non-trusted user, Ballaji_Vijayan, did disclose buying 2% of portfolio, expecting to raise to 5%, in Aug 2025).

bull_case: Q1FY27 delivered on the community's own checklist: PAT >Rs 100 Cr, operating cash flow positive for the first time, advance-gold mix rising toward ~20%
Real, specific growth targets (~Rs 8,100 Cr FY27 revenue, 30-35% sustainable growth) reiterated across concalls without further equity dilution; capacity at only ~60% util, sufficient to 2028
Advance-gold model structurally lowers inventory funding and receivable intensity - the mechanism that fixes the cash-conversion problem, and it is visibly ramping
A trusted user explicitly called the promoter-selling episode a buying opportunity with business economics intact; promoter holding 51.74% with zero pledge
MCX hedging and 15-day repricing genuinely mitigate gold-price volatility in the making-charge model
bear_case: One quarter of positive operating cash flow is not a trend; FY25 OCF was -Rs 273 Cr and gross debt is still ~Rs 540 Cr
EBITDA margin is thin (~7.8%) - the model depends on volume, mix and working-capital discipline all going right simultaneously
The Feb-2026 receivables concern (>Rs 600 Cr, a disputed Gensol comparison) is improving but not fully retired; quality-of-earnings still warrants quarter-by-quarter tracking
Stock trades at ~36x earnings, pricing in continued flawless 30%+ growth and the cash-conversion turn holding
Poorly-managed concalls around the 2025 promoter-selling episode dented confidence in IR discipline; no trusted user has disclosed a position size in favour
verdict_headline: A genuine B2B jewellery scale-up whose Q1FY27 print starts to close the cash-conversion gap the community had flagged, still to be confirmed over more quarters and against a rich multiple
verdict_reasoning: Q1FY27 hit the community's stated bar (PAT >Rs 100 Cr, CFO positive, advance-gold mix rising) - the single biggest bear point (OCF-negative) is now improving, not just promised

value_chain.note: Organised retailers increasingly outsource manufacturing to a few scaled players; SkyGold is among the largest, but it is a price-taker on making charges with thin margins - scale and WC discipline are the edge, not pricing power.

earnings_quality.normalised_note: EBITDA margin ~7.8% and gross margin ~9.3% are near the low end for the model, not a peak; the risk is the opposite - that margins stay structurally thin and WC-sensitive rather than expanding as guided.

growth_trajectory.last_quarters_note: Revenue YoY (approx, oldest->newest): mid-2025 standalone growth decelerated with 3 quarters of flat gold volumes; FY26 PAT +102%; Q3FY26 PAT +~120%; Q1FY27 revenue +78%, PAT +141%. Recent trajectory is re-accelerating on exports and advance-gold.
growth_trajectory.reverse_pe_note: ~36x trailing needs ~30-35% EPS CAGR FY26-28 at a ~25x exit; the guided ~Rs 8,100 Cr FY27 revenue and 4.5-5.25% PAT margin roughly support it, leaving little valuation cushion if growth slips.

management_quality.capital_allocation: Reinvesting into capacity and working capital at high headline ROCE (~27%); capex staged and modest (Rs 80-100 Cr next tranche); Ganna & Gold bolt-on acquisition; funded growth partly via a 2025 preferential warrant issue rather than pure internal accrual
management_quality.capability_ladder_note: Moving up mix from plain gold to studded/18kt and value-added products, and from domestic to exports; advance-gold model is a genuine business-model upgrade

track_record.note: Of FY23-FY25 verifiable from filings, roughly 1 year cleared both revenue growth >=10% and ROCE >=15% cleanly - FY25 ROCE was strong on headline but OCF was -Rs 273 Cr, so earnings quality that year is questionable. The business only recently reached the scale where per-year screens are meaningful; treat with caution.
